title: Anti-air reaction practice
bullet_points:
Watch the upper lane
Respond only to the chosen cue
Reset immediately after each attempt

title: Hit-confirm practice
bullet_points:
Use a random visual cue
Continue only after confirming it
Stop and reset after a miss
goal: Five correct decisions in a row

title: Defensive response drill
bullet_points:
Recognize the pressure pattern
Choose one safe response
Review mistakes after the session
